name: @wing-agent/web
//: The mobile-friendly web client: a Vite + React shell that talks to the wing gateway directly (dev: vite proxy / prod: the gateway hosts the built assets, see step 03). Private and never published — `vite build` is the artifact. Workspace member of the root pnpm workspace (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`), so `pnpm -r run lint|format:check|typecheck|test` (what `make check-ts` / `make test-ts` and CI run) picks it up without any registration.

scripts.shot: pnpm run build && node esbuild.shot.mjs && node out/shot/shot.mjs

//devDependencies: Everything here is a build/test-time dependency: the app bundle itself only ships react / react-dom / the two workspace packages. `ws` backs the screenshot fixture gateway (a dev tool, bundled into `out/shot`); `playwright` drives the local Chrome for screenshots and never runs in CI.
